definition: In neuroscience and computer science, synaptic weight refers to the strength or amplitude of a connection between two nodes, corresponding in biology to the amount of influence the firing of one neuron has on another.
details: The term is typically used in artificial and biological neural network research.
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. And that shape of the machine — Synaptic weight — is what makes everything else possible.
